question: Identify the ANTONYM pair.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Encourage"** means to give support, confidence, or hope to someone. (प्रोत्साहित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Her parents always encourage her to pursue her dreams.
 
 
 
• **"Dissuade" **means to persuade someone not to take a particular course of action. (मना करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He tried to dissuade her from quitting her job.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Encourage' **is **'Dissuade'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Encourage and Support** (प्रोत्साहित और समर्थन): Both words mean to give help or approval to someone.

 
 
• **Example:** Teachers encourage and support their students to achieve their best.
 
 
 
• **Influence and Motivate** (प्रभावित और प्रेरित करना): Both words mean to affect or inspire someone to take action.
 
 
• **Example: **Great leaders influence and motivate their teams.
 
 
 
• **Convince and Persuade** (मनाना और राजी करना): Both words mean to cause someone to believe or do something.
 
 
• **Example: **She convinced and persuaded her friend to join the club.
 
 

31:Te75,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
